text.en:
Transferring LRA from OENR to the DOJ. - The LRA is hereby
transferred from the DENR to the DOJ in order to ensure a more effective and efficient
execution of laws relative to land registration.

Repealing Clause, - All executive orders, including Executive Order
No. 690, series of 2007, rules and regulation, and other issuances or parts thereof that
are inconsistent with the provisions of this Executive Order, are hereby either revoked
or modified accordingly
OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT
OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENTIAL SPOKESPERSON
